⟦カラー→カラー：10820_karaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{印刷|いんさつ}します⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{白黒|しろくろ}→白黒：13642_shirokuro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{印刷|いんさつ}します⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

notes:
The process of producing text or images on paper. Functions as a noun and する verb.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]を{印刷|いんさつ}する

WORD FORMATION:
{印|いん} (seal/stamp) + {刷|さつ} (print/rub)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {印刷|いんさつ}⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧: printed matter
- {印刷|いんさつ}⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧: printing press/printer
- {印刷|いんさつ}⟦{所|じょ}→〜所：09844_sho⟧/{印刷|いんさつ}⟦{会社|がいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧: printing company
- ⟦カラー→カラー：10820_karaa⟧{印刷|いんさつ}: color printing
- ⟦{両面|りょうめん}→両面：11366_ryoumen⟧{印刷|いんさつ}: double-sided printing

CONTRAST:
- {印刷|いんさつ}: printing (the process)
- ⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧: publishing (making available to the public)
- ⟦プリント→プリント：01539_purinto⟧(する): print (loanword, common for personal/office printing)

{印刷|いんさつ} covers both commercial/industrial printing and everyday document printing.
